material.description: Buy, qualify and reserve actual components

property-concept.description: Find qualifying materials and acceptance tests

inscription-concept.description: Install and prepare, or follow the baseline focus rule

recipe-concept.description: Fabricate the linked artifact with the same prerequisites

spell-construction.description: Build, test, prepare and cast; baseline forms use the existing spellbook

spell-explanation.description: Read alongside the linked spell and its current rules

ritual-concept.description: Assign actual roles and complete their work

room-purpose.description: Set purpose against actual capacity and services

furnishing-concept.description: Craft functional fitting or select decorative treatment

adjacency-synergy.description: Arrange matching rooms; numerical support only where implemented

site-template.description: Travel, select leads, work and return

lead-template.description: Visit its site and conduct the lead

discovery-template.description: Archive actual returned observations and follow material or study links

encounter-template.description: Choose an approach on an actual trip

care-case.description: Voluntary care episode with support work and unconditional exit

community-template.description: Establish a neighbour through an assigned introduction

contact-role.description: Meet a named independent contact after community introduction

service-concept.description: Fund a bounded service between actual qualified household parties

personal-arc.description: Joined chapter invitations, assigned work and chosen outcomes

relationship-development.description: Shared conversations and individually chosen developments

scene-template.description: Compose, review and join an optional invitation

letter-template.description: Draft, edit and deliver once to a named household recipient

commission-concept.description: Deliver an actual matching owned output once

gift-or-keepsake.description: Acquire and offer an actual owned gift

book-or-document.description: Acquire, read and discuss an owned copy

food-or-drink.description: Prepare and serve an actual meal once

garden-specimen.description: Establish and observe a conservatory specimen

curiosity.description: Acquire and examine an owned curiosity

room-art-brief.description: Prepare a brief tied to an actual room and accepted reference

object-art-brief.description: Prepare a brief tied to an owned object

wardrobe-art-brief.description: Save compatible garments and prepare a resident-specific art brief

feedback-copy.description: Troubleshooting guidance with suggested next action

acceptance-scenario.description: Execute and record an evidenced manual check; never mark a preview as passed

background-mapping.description: Apply bounded packages to all mapped occupations at candidate creation

starting-package-concept.description: New scholar or reviewed new candidate only

perk-concept.description: Earn, prepare and use the actual method

training-opportunity.description: Start a real two-person lesson in a referenced subject

mechanics-proposal.description: Fixed shipped adapter; uploaded prose never executes
